tasks.prompt: Implement the synchronous remote-app extension of open issue #780 in authlib.integrations.base_client.sync_app.OAuth2Base._get_oauth_client. When configuring a token-endpoint-only OAuth client without grant_type and without access_token_params, classify it as client_credentials before constructing the session so an expired client-credentials token can refresh on a resource request. Do not override explicit grant_type, authorization-code configuration, or parameterized grants; do not send a resource bearer token to the token endpoint.
acceptance: A token-endpoint-only remote app with no explicit grant_type classifies the grant as client_credentials.
An expired client-credentials token refreshes during a resource request without directing that request to the token endpoint.
The factory session is deterministically closed after the request scope.

tasks.prompt: Implement the synchronous reusable-session extension of open issue #822 in authlib.integrations.base_client.sync_app.OAuth2Base._get_oauth_client. Add OAuth2Mixin.client(token=None, request=None) as a context manager that yields one authenticated OAuth client for multiple resource calls. Obtain a token through the existing request-token callback when none is supplied, reject a missing token before yielding, bind it through _get_oauth_client, and always close the client on exit. Keep callbacks, token updates, request authentication, and one-shot requests intact; do not add an async API.
acceptance: with app.client(token=token) yields one OAuth session for multiple resource calls.
A missing supplied or request-backed token raises MissingTokenError before a session is created.
The client closes on context exit and resource calls do not invoke the token-update callback.

tasks.prompt: Fix Authlib issue #783 in authlib.oauth2.client.OAuth2Client.ensure_active_token. acceptance: Expired client-credentials renewal sends registered access_token_params such as audience.
Metadata grant_type cannot override client_credentials and the metadata mapping is not mutated.
OAuth token errors propagate and a successful renewal retains the update_token callback contract.

tasks.prompt: Implement Authlib issue #632 in authlib.oauth2.client.OAuth2Client.ensure_active_token. Keep default automatic behavior and errors unchanged; explicit refresh_token remains available.
acceptance: token_auto_update=False returns False for an expired token without a token-endpoint request.
The opt-out wins when refresh_token and token_endpoint are both present.
Default client-credentials renewal and explicit refresh_token behavior remain available.
